title: Dyson Black Friday deals 2026 UK: the best prices now
description: Today's Dyson Black Friday prices on vacuums, Airwrap, Supersonic and Airstrait, checked against last year's lows so you know which deals are real.
intro:
**The best Dyson deal this Black Friday weekend is the Dyson V8 Origin at £199.99 at Amazon, £130 off and level with last year's best V8 price.** The Clean+Wash Hygiene floor cleaner is at its cheapest yet, £239.99 at Amazon, and Dyson's own site has the Supersonic Origin at £174.99 and the Airwrap i.d. at £349.99, with code **SAVE15** taking another £15 off this weekend.

Other offers still live: the Ball Animal 3 upright is £259.99 and the V10 Konical with its auto-empty dock £398 at Amazon, and the Spot+Scrub AI robot is about £649. We still haven't found dated UK deals on the V12 Detect Slim or V15 Detect this week, so don't pay full price for those. Prices on this page were reported on 27 and 28 November 2026 (TechRadar, Which?); check the retailer before you buy. The sale runs to Cyber Monday, 30 November. More offers on our [Black Friday live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).

body:
## Dyson prices to aim for

These are the prices Dyson's most popular models reached around Black Friday 2025, or their lowest in the last six months. If you see one at or below this figure, it's a real deal.

- **V8 Advanced:** £199 (John Lewis, Black Friday 2025)
- **Cyclone V10 Total Clean:** £279 (Currys, Black Friday 2025)
- **V11 Extra:** about £337 (John Lewis, Black Friday 2025)
- **V12 Detect Slim Absolute:** £349 (John Lewis, Black Friday 2025)
- **V15 Detect Absolute:** about £450 to £480
- **V15s Detect Submarine:** £599
- **V16 Piston Animal:** under £590 (six-month low)
- **Airwrap i.d.:** £329
- **Supersonic:** around £200 to £210

Which? also publishes its own "genuine saving" lines. Its threshold for the V15 is under £550, the V12 under £449 and the V8 Animal under £329. Treat those as the minimum: anything above them isn't really a deal.

## When does Dyson's Black Friday sale end?

Black Friday was on Friday 27 November, and Dyson's sale, like Amazon's Black Friday Week, runs to **Cyber Monday, 30 November**. Dyson's own deals started at the end of October, and this weekend it has added an extra £15 off sale prices with code SAVE15 (TechRadar, 28 November). After Cyber Monday some prices usually stay down into December, but the best ones tend to end on the Monday night.

## Buy from Dyson or a retailer?

Retailers are usually cheaper than Dyson on vacuums: this weekend Amazon has the best prices on the V8 Origin, Clean+Wash Hygiene and Ball Animal 3, while Dyson's own site is cheapest for hair tools. Dyson's own site also has some models the shops don't, such as the Gen5detect. A few things make Dyson's own site worth checking:

- **Two-year guarantee** on vacuums, hair tools, purifiers and fans when you buy new.
- **Price-match refund:** Dyson says it will refund the difference if you find the same product cheaper at an eligible UK retailer within 35 days.
- **Bundles and personalisation** you can't get elsewhere. Just check the 'was' price on a bundle: the V15 bundle's £699.99 includes extra tools, so the saving is smaller than it looks.

**Refurbished:** Dyson's refurbished store usually takes £80 to £100 off, but you only get a one-year guarantee and most items were out of stock when we checked.

## Which Dyson vacuum should you buy?

**Small flat or mostly hard floors:** the V12 Detect Slim is light and easy to carry upstairs. It reached £349.99 earlier this month but we haven't seen a dated deal on it this week, so aim for £349 to £399.

**Bigger house, carpets or pets:** the V15 Detect has more suction, a longer battery and a laser that shows up dust on hard floors. It dropped to £479 on 17 November; don't pay much over £500. If you'd rather avoid batteries, the corded Ball Animal 3 at £259.99 is strong on carpets and pet hair.

**Lots of hard floors:** add the Clean+Wash Hygiene (£239.99 at Amazon) or pick a Submarine model that mops as well as vacuums.

**On a budget:** the V8 Origin at £199.99 at Amazon is the one to buy; it does a good job in a flat or smaller home.

### Is it worth waiting for Cyber Monday for a Dyson?

Not for the V8 Origin, Clean+Wash Hygiene or Supersonic Origin: they already match or beat last year's best prices, and Cyber Monday is usually the same or slightly worse. For the V12 and V15, which aren't on a deal we can confirm, compare against the target prices above before you buy.

### Are Dyson Black Friday discounts real?

Mostly, but the 'was' prices are high and bundles can make savings look bigger than they are. Compare against the target prices above rather than the percentage off.

### Is Amazon cheaper for Dyson?

This weekend, yes for vacuums: Amazon has the best prices on the V8 Origin (£199.99), Clean+Wash Hygiene (£239.99) and Ball Animal 3 (£259.99). For hair tools, Dyson's own site is cheapest right now, especially with code SAVE15. Many Amazon Black Friday prices need Prime: see our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/).

### Dyson or Shark?

Shark is usually cheaper and has a longer warranty if you register it; Dyson is lighter and has the dust-sensing extras. Our [Shark vs Dyson cordless guide](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/) compares them model by model, and the [Shark Black Friday deals 2026](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/) guide has Shark prices.

See also [Black Friday 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
